_doc: Seed leylines. Named traditional leys are C-traditional with authored polylines (no canonical dataset exists — see SOURCE_ATLAS gaps). Detected lines are written by the Loom, not stored here.

leylines.name: St Michael & Mary Line
leylines.note: The classic SW→NE alignment through Glastonbury Tor and Avebury, after Michell/Miller/Broadhurst. Polyline is an authored interpretation; the dowsed 'currents' are unmeasurable.
